testimonials.heading: Words of Appreciation
testimonials.subtitle: Thousands of students use StudentOS to build their academic future.
testimonials.r1_quote: I rewrote my CV with StudentOS and got 3 interview calls in one week. The ATS checker alone was worth it — I had no idea my old CV was scoring 32%.
testimonials.r2_quote: The learning plan feature helped me structure my prep for internship season. I went from zero offers to two competing offers in a single semester.
testimonials.r3_quote: Plagiarism checker saved me from submitting an essay with accidental similarity. The dashboard makes it so easy to track everything in one place.
testimonials.r4_quote: The scholarship finder helped me discover opportunities I never knew existed. Found three scholarships and successfully applied for two of them.
